title: Validate live supplier comparison references before procurement commitment
description: Complete the supplier comparison-to-purchase-order master reference path. PurchaseQuoteMutationRules.ValidateDraft validates prices/quantities/currency/status but does not load the explicitly supplied product/supplier/customer; PurchaseQuoteController.Create/Update and approval persist those references, and PurchaseQuoteConversion copies SupplierId/ProductId into generated procurement documents. Add bounded live reference checks to draft writes, approval/selection, authorized single and batch conversion before number reservation or writes, using existing supplier-comparison and procurement authority. Nullable supplier/product comparisons remain valid drafts where currently supported; commitment must meet existing supplier/product requirements, never silently make ProductId=0 a live purchase reference. Historical snapshots stay readable, unchanged. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Reject explicitly supplied zero/negative, missing/deleted/disabled product/supplier/customer references, while preserving supported nullable/manual comparison drafts. Enforce existing customer scope and commercial/status checks without new master-maintenance permission requirements or grants.

Revalidate selected/approved comparisons and single/batch procurement conversion against live masters inside existing deterministic source locks. Load master references in bounded batches; reject an invalid batch atomically before any purchase number/write, never create partial purchase groups or silently reassign source references.

Rules/controller and genuine isolated SQL tests cover draft create/update, selection/approval, master invalidation, single/batch conversion with one invalid source, manual/null draft semantics, denied zero writes/numbering and authorized valid procurement. Preserve existing price/selection/history and conversion regressions; run safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: PurchaseQuoteMutationRules.ValidateDraft:288-322 checks QuoteNo/status/Quantity/QuotePrice/Currency/TotalAmount but no database master references. PurchaseQuoteController.Create:119-135 and Update use that validation then persistence. PurchaseQuoteConversion.FromQuote copies SupplierId??0 and ProductId??0 into procurement drafts; existing ERP-417/418 protect terms and atomic conversion and ERP-427 protects ordinary purchase order entry, not every comparison-source master reference.
